Redis driver implementation for the OVAL dictionary database, providing CRUD operations for OVAL security definitions using Redis as the backend store.

## Key Components

| Symbol | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `RedisDriver` | struct | Main driver struct holding the Redis client connection |
| `OpenDB` | method | Parses a Redis URL and establishes a connection |
| `CloseDB` | method | Closes the Redis client connection |
| `MigrateDB` | method | No-op stub (schema migration not required for Redis) |
| `GetByPackName` | method | Retrieves OVAL definitions matching a given OS family, version, and package name |
| `GetByCveID` | method | Retrieves OVAL definitions matching a given OS family, version, and CVE ID |
| `GetAdvisories` | method | Returns a map of advisory ID → CVE IDs for a given OS family/version |
| `InsertOval` | method | Bulk-inserts an OVAL root (definitions, CVE/package indexes, advisories) into Redis |
| `restoreDefinition` | func | Deserializes a JSON definition string and filters packages by arch or RedHat major version |

### Redis Key Schema

| Key Pattern | Type | Purpose |
|-------------|------|---------|
| `OVAL#$FAMILY#$VER#DEF` | Hash | Stores serialized definition JSON, keyed by definition ID |
| `OVAL#$FAMILY#$VER#PKG#$PKG` | Set | Maps package name → set of definition IDs |
| `OVAL#$FAMILY#$VER#CVE#$CVE` | Set | Maps CVE ID → set of definition IDs |
| `OVAL#$FAMILY#$VER#ADV` | Hash | Maps advisory ID → JSON array of CVE IDs |
| `OVAL#$FAMILY#$VER#DEP` | String | Dependency manifest used to clean stale keys |
| `OVAL#FETCHMETA` | Hash | Stores schema version, binary revision, and last fetch timestamp |

## Usage Example

```go
driver := &RedisDriver{name: "redis"}

err := driver.OpenDB("", "redis://localhost:6379/0", false, Option{})
if err != nil {
    log.Fatal(err)
}
defer driver.CloseDB()

// Look up definitions by package name
defs, err := driver.GetByPackName("redhat", "8", "openssl", "x86_64")

// Look up definitions by CVE
defs, err = driver.GetByCveID("ubuntu", "22.04", "CVE-2023-1234", "")

// Retrieve advisory-to-CVE mapping
advisories, err := driver.GetAdvisories("debian", "11")
```
